rationale: This inscription is an Athenian inventory of the mid-4th century BC, likely from the Acropolis. It records the transfer of sacred and public property between boards of treasurers. The text lists a variety of objects, including golden crowns, silver phialai, and a significant amount of bronze military equipment (shields, catapult parts, greaves) stored in the Chalkotheke (Bronze Storehouse). It mentions specific archon years (Polyzelus and likely Pytheas) to date the records and refers to the tribe Erechtheis.
